description:
Fixed recurring bills (Rent, Auto Insurance, Renters Insurance, Phone, Internet) hit 100% of their limit every month as part of normal operation — but the dashboard currently renders that in red/alarm colors as if it were an overage. Add an `is_fixed: bool` flag on Category (mirroring is_income). Semantics for fixed categories: spent==limit (±small tolerance) renders a muted "paid" state (green or neutral, not red); spent<limit renders muted "pending" (bill hasn't posted yet); spent>limit renders red "surprise" (genuinely interesting — rent went up). Alert emails: skip the 80% and 100% thresholds for fixed categories (they'd fire every month as the bill posts — pure noise) but keep the overage alert for actual surprises.

Scope:
1. Schema: ALTER TABLE category ADD COLUMN is_fixed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
2. Settings: Fixed checkbox next to the existing Income checkbox
3. Dashboard: three visual states (paid / pending / surprise) for fixed categories instead of the standard ok/warn/over bars
4. Alerts: skip 80% and 100% thresholds in sync_service's crossing logic when is_fixed; keep >100% as "surprise" alert
5. Tests
6. Migration note in deploy
title: Fixed-cost category kind (paid vs over for recurring bills)
